n: Elecfreaks Nezha Pro AI Mechanical Power Kit
t: A building kit with voice and gesture sensors that students program with blocks.
steps: Find the kit through a retailer such as Little Bird.
Check which version you are buying. Only one version includes a micro:bit.
Ask the seller which programming editor the kit uses.
Build the first guided case with students.
Attach the voice and gesture sensors.
Program the micro:bit from a computer with a browser.
Test each sensor in a quiet room.
